description: Report that you have written the given approved fixes into the site and DEPLOYED them. geoa then fetches the public page as an ordinary visitor and confirms the change is really there — a fix is closed by measurement, never by claim, so a report made before the change is live stays unconfirmed. Writes to the customer's geoa account. Requires sign-in to a geoa account.

commit.description: Optional commit SHA or reference the change landed in

deployed_url.description: Optional URL where the change is now live

fix_ids.description: The fix_ids you wrote in and deployed (from geoa_pending_fixes)

rolled_back.description: Optional {fix_id: reason} for changes you reverted instead of keeping

tool_version.description: Optional client/tool identifier for the report

name: geoa_report_fixes_live
title: Report Fixes Written and Deployed
